claims.claim: VIAVI is extending its test portfolio into 1.6T AI-fabric validation across scale-up, scale-out and scale-across architectures, with 3.2T planning already referenced in September product positioning.

The portfolio now spans high-speed Ethernet, silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, fiber monitoring and quantum/hybrid network evaluation, increasing exposure to AI-infrastructure validation bottlenecks.

risks.risk: Product breadth and technical relevance do not by themselves establish durable pricing power or market-share capture.

unknowns.unknown: Revenue contribution and competitive share of the newest 1.6T/AI-fabric products remain unquantified here.

claims.claim: FY2026 revenue was $1.518B, up 40% year over year; Q4 revenue was $443.1M, up 52.5%, with Q4 non-GAAP operating margin of 24.0%.
September product activity reinforces the AI-data-center demand thesis, but FY GAAP loss and acquisition/financing complexity still require underwriting reconciliation.

risks.risk: FY GAAP net loss, acquisition integration and normalization of rapid datacenter growth remain material execution variables.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong revenue and non-GAAP profitability growth coexist with a FY GAAP net loss.

unknowns.unknown: Organic versus acquired growth contribution and durability of current margin gains remain unresolved.
